description: This file defines data structures and parsing logic related to voice or speech directives in a speech synthesis or voice communication system. It includes structs for representing directives, results of parsing, and a parser that interprets JSON-encoded directives within text input.

classes.name: TalkDirective
classes.description: A struct representing various parameters for speech synthesis directives, such as voice ID, model ID, speed, stability, etc.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParseResult
classes.description: A struct encapsulating the result of parsing a directive, including the parsed directive, the remaining text after stripping the directive, and any unknown keys identified.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParser
classes.description: A static class providing a method to parse a text string into a TalkDirectiveParseResult based on JSON content within the text.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string to extract speech directive parameters encoded in JSON, returning a structured result with the directive and remaining text.
